newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.054 bln stg in week to Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.054 bln stg in week to Feb 5.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.054 billion stg in the week to February 5 from 25.052 billion in the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 24.429 billion stg from 24.361 billion previously.

Notes and coins in circulation rose to a seaonally adjusted 24.815 billion stg in the week to February 5, from 24.781 billion stg previously, while on an unadjusted basis they rose to 24.190 billion from 24.090 billion previously.
